evidence.note: The unfenced arm returns [fence, fence !== undefined], so a defined nextOpenFence is only written with isFenced true. In-fence arms at 48-53 always write isFenced true, including the closer [undefined, true]. [marker, false] is never constructed.
jsdocCommentEnd copies nextOpenFence into openFence and only searches for */ when !isFenced. A defined marker with isFenced false is unreachable, so payload presence implies the flag.
The reader branches on !isFenced to treat the line as comment text; combined marker-plus-false is not a handled fence role.

notes: Fence-scanner role unfenced | open(marker) | closing. isFenced is not a restatement of marker presence: the closer is true with undefined marker.

disqualifier.note: Independent opener observations (whitespace-only prefix vs plausible body after /**). Combined-true extracts the block; the other three tuples skip. AND of two free facts, not a masked union.

evidence.note: turboEnvExtendsAmbient is assigned !isOpRunTurbo at its only producer, so equal pairs of those two bits are unrepresentable.

turboEnvOverrides returns {} when both spawn classifiers are false, then the wrapped-op arm behind !directTurbo. command cannot be bunx and op together, and the extends alias never appears as a third combined-true spawn kind.

notes: Expansion of turboEnvOverrides.spawnKind with omitted NOT alias. Legal: non-turbo (extends), direct bunx turbo (extends), op-run turbo (!extends).
